BRIGHTLINE HOME APPLIANCES — EXTENDED WARRANTY CERTIFICATE EW-5540981 (EXTRACT) AND CLAIM RECORD

Product: Brightline FrostPro 70 fridge-freezer, serial FP70-2208-11934.
Delivery date: 31 August 2026.
Term. This extended warranty covers breakdowns reported during the period that starts on the delivery date and ends 18 months later. Where the calendar month in which the period ends has no day with the same number as the delivery day, the period ends on the last day of that month. The period ends at 24:00 on its last day.
Time reference. All times are determined in Brightline's local time at its claims centre in Rotterdam, Central European Time (UTC+1 in winter). Claims submitted online are time-stamped in the customer's local time and must be converted.
Claims. A claim is "reported" when the online claim form is submitted or a phone call to the claims line begins.
Exclusions (extract). Cosmetic damage; consumables such as light bulbs and water filters; damage from power surges unless a surge protector was used.

Claim record CL-28-00471
Customer location: Halifax, Nova Scotia. Customer's local time zone on the submission date: UTC−4.
Online claim form submitted: 29 February 2028 at 18:30 customer local time.
Fault: compressor does not start; freezer compartment at +12 °C.
Claims centre note (1 March 2028): "18 months from 31 August 2026 lands on 28 February 2028, so the cover ended the day before this claim. Recommend decline."
Previous claims: none.

decision.instructions: Was claim CL-28-00471 reported within the extended warranty period of certificate EW-5540981?

criteria.false: The claim was reported after the warranty period ended.
criteria.true: The claim was reported before the end of the warranty period (in Rotterdam time).
